
```{r setup, include = TRUE}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(glue)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(gtsummary)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)
library(tableone)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
conf <- config::get()
```

```{r load-data}
pre_matching_dataset <- read.csv(here("data/processed/converter_dataset.csv"))
pre_matching_dataset <- pre_matching_dataset %>% mutate(
        site = case_when(
            scanner == "mnc_old_philips" ~ "mnc_ms",
            scanner == "macs_ms" ~ "macs_ms",
            str_starts(scanner, "macs_mr") ~ "macs_mr",
            TRUE ~ NA_character_
        )
    )
pre_matching_baseline_dataset <- pre_matching_dataset %>%
    group_by(subject_id) %>%
    slice_min(assessment, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup()

brainager_predictions <- read.csv(here("data/processed/converter_dataset_matched_corrected.csv"))

lmer_data <- brainager_predictions %>%
    filter(!is.na(brain_age), !is.na(assessment_exact)) %>%
    mutate(
        scanner = as.factor(scanner),
        site = as.factor(site),
        sex = as.factor(sex),
        tiv = gmv + wmv + csf,
        BAG = brain_age - chronological_age,
        group = factor(group, levels = c("HC", "MDD", "CON"), labels = c("HC", "MDD", "CON"))
    ) %>%
    select(BAG, BAG_corrected, brain_age, cohort, subject_id, assessment, assessment_exact, group, sex, scanner, site, chronological_age, tiv, HAMD17, bdi, cesd, BMI, medindex, tiv, duration_episodes_depr, recurrence)

baseline_dataset <- lmer_data %>% filter(assessment_exact == 0)
```

```{r}
lmer_data %>% filter(assessment != 0) |> ggplot(aes(x = chronological_age, fill = cohort)) +
    geom_density(position = "identity", alpha = 0.5, color = "white") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
        title = "Age Distribution by Group",
        x = "Age (Years)",
        y = "Count",
        fill = "Group"
    )
```

# Brain age Correction
```{r ggplot}
# Filter out a baseline HC sample from your main data to check
check_data <- brainager_predictions %>% filter(group == "HC", assessment_exact == 0)

# Plot 1: Uncorrected (Should show a downward slope)
p1 <- ggplot(check_data, aes(x = chronological_age, y = BAG)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.5, color = "darkred") +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = "Uncorrected BAG", y = "Raw BAG", x = "Chronological Age")

# Plot 2: Corrected (Should be perfectly flat)
p2 <- ggplot(check_data, aes(x = chronological_age, y = BAG_corrected)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.5, color = "steelblue") +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = "Bias-Corrected BAG", y = "Corrected BAG", x = "Chronological Age")

# Plot 2: Corrected (Should be perfectly flat)
# p3 <- ggplot(check_data, aes(x = chronological_age, y = BAG_cohort_corrected)) +

#     theme_minimal() +
#     labs(title = "Per Cohort Corrected BAG", y = "Cohort-Corrected BAG", x = "Chronological Age")

# Display side-by-side
p1 + p2 # + p3
```

```{r}
# Are the groups different in age at baseline?
# Formula: Dependent Variable (age) ~ Independent Variable (group)
age_anova <- aov(chronological_age ~ group, data = lmer_data %>% filter(assessment == 0))

# normality of residuals
shapiro_result <- shapiro.test(residuals(age_anova))

if (shapiro_result$p.value > 0.05) {
    # If normality is not rejected, use ANOVA
    print("normality assumption met, using ANOVA")
    anova_result <- summary(age_anova)
    print(anova_result)
    if (anova_result[[1]]$`Pr(>F)`[1] < 0.05) {
        print("The groups are differently distributed in age.")
    } else {
        print("The groups are not differently distributed in age.")
    }
} else {
    # If normality is rejected, use Kruskal-Wallis test
    print("normality assumption not met, using Kruskal-Wallis test")
    kruskal_result <- kruskal.test(chronological_age ~ group, data = lmer_data %>% filter(assessment == 0))
    print(kruskal_result)
    if (kruskal_result$p.value < 0.05) {
        print("The groups are differently distributed in age.")
    } else {
        print("The groups are not differently distributed in age.")
    }
}
```

```{r}
table1_data <- pre_matching_baseline_dataset %>%
    mutate(cohort = case_when(
        cohort == "bidirect" ~ "Replication",
        TRUE ~ "Discovery"
    )) %>%
    filter(!is.na(chronological_age), !is.na(brain_age), !is.na(sex)) %>%
    select(cohort, group, chronological_age, sex, HAMD17, bdi, cesd)

table1 <- table1_data %>% tbl_strata(
    strata = cohort,
    .tbl_fun = ~.x %>%
        tbl_summary(
            by = group,                               # Split the table by HC, MDD, CON
            statistic = list(
                all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd}), N = {N_nonmiss}",     # Show Mean (SD) and non-missing count for age
                all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"        # Show Count (%) for Sex/Site
            ),
            label = list(
                chronological_age ~ "Age (Years)",
                sex ~ "Sex"
            ),
            missing = "no",
            digits = list(all_continuous() ~ c(2, 2))
        ) %>%
        add_overall(),
    modify_header(all_stat_cols() ~ "**{level}**")
  )

# View the table
table1 # %>% flextable::save_as_docx(path = here("output/sample_description.docx"))
```

```{r}
table1_scan_data <- pre_matching_dataset %>%
    mutate(cohort = case_when(
        cohort == "bidirect" ~ "Replication",
        TRUE ~ "Discovery"
    )) %>%
    filter(!is.na(chronological_age), !is.na(brain_age), !is.na(sex)) %>%
    group_by(cohort, subject_id) %>%
    mutate(n_row = n()) %>%
    slice_min(assessment, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    group_by(cohort, group) %>%
    summarise(
        sum_rows_per_subject = sum(n_row, na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_rows_per_subject = mean(n_row, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_rows_per_subject = sd(n_row, na.rm = TRUE)
    )

table1_scan_data
```

pairwise SMD for the discovery and replication datasets, before and after matching.
```{r}
cat("\ndiscovery dataset\n")
pre  <- CreateTableOne(vars = c("chronological_age","sex","tiv","scanner"), strata = "group", data = pre_matching_baseline_dataset %>% filter(cohort != "bidirect"), test = FALSE)
post <- CreateTableOne(vars = c("chronological_age","sex","tiv","scanner"), strata = "group", data = baseline_dataset %>% filter(cohort != "bidirect"),  test = FALSE)
ExtractSmd(pre); ExtractSmd(post)   # with >2 groups, returns the average pairwise SMD per variable
cat("\nreplication dataset\n")
pre  <- CreateTableOne(vars = c("chronological_age","sex","tiv","scanner"), strata = "group", data = pre_matching_baseline_dataset %>% filter(cohort == "bidirect"), test = FALSE)
post <- CreateTableOne(vars = c("chronological_age","sex","tiv","scanner"), strata = "group", data = baseline_dataset %>% filter(cohort == "bidirect"),  test = FALSE)
ExtractSmd(pre); ExtractSmd(post)   # with >2 groups, returns the average pairwise SMD per variable
```
